## Limits and next milestone

This cooperative basic-job translation includes native demonstration routines
and P66 preparation through PDVL GDT/2. Complete flight OS and guidance workloads
remain future work. Callbacks return to a trampoline; persistent values belong
in MPAC/VAC, not suspended C stacks.
An unmapped address latches a runtime fault. No rollback is claimed; bounded
explicit recovery is documented in RESTART.md. Idle dispatch uses a bounded
A=2/L=0 convention, not Apollo self-check.

The IRQ handler publishes through `exec_irq_post`; it must never mutate Executive
state or invoke native dispatch. Foreground wrappers restore IRQ state and admit
at declared safe points. The C64 IRQ/task builds require `-fno-static-stack -mlto-zp=0`;
the legacy console build is unbound and uses the usual compiler defaults.
Source rate, callbacks and masked intervals still need application bounds;
finite raster testing does not establish an unconditional delivery deadline.

Next guidance stage: VSU VBIAS, implicit quotient-fed VXSC, shifts and velocity
accumulation through STOVL 24D/R. Parallel work adds reusable vector arithmetic,
Executive services, phase maintenance and general scalar arithmetic.
Interpreter dispatch, flight deadlines and physical hardware verification remain open. See ROADMAP.md.

Acceptance for basic dispatch, IRQ delivery, lifecycle, bounded WAITLIST,
bounded Type C job recovery, pre-interpreter P66 preparation, VXSC KPIP1, PDDL THISTPIP, DSU PIPTIME, STORE 30D and fixed-divisor DDV is met using the hardware-DV oracle
(see DIVIDE.md for the pinned fast-path discrepancy).
No master/upstream merge is needed.
No second-agent/human review was performed. Native C is MIT/public-domain
translation; the separate GPL-2.0-or-later original-assembly adapters are host
verification tools and are never linked into the C64 executable.

The final 2048-word image, IRQ and SUPER equal the pinned yaAGC oracle for all 65536 sampled call chains from the actual SR30.1 callers (strict and ASAN/UBSAN), 297 intermediate phase frontiers equal original NEWOPS images, 266 assembled words map to native literals after a fresh yaYUL assembly, and four C64 phase diagnostics pass 63 frozen steps in VICE that take every branch outcome the host stream takes. See `docs/LM-TIME-FREE-FALL.md`.

## Run Luminary Executive and Waitlist service entries as native routines

Luminary099 NOVAC, FINDVAC, WAITLIST, TWIDDLE and the WAITLIST.agc LONGCALL chain (LONGCALL, LNGCALL2, LONGCYCL, LONGRTRN, GETCADR) are routines of the control-transfer ABI. They take their inline 2CADR or ADRES from a site table compiled from the source (146 call sites, 268 words), so RESTARTS now reaches real job and task admission instead of stubs. All 9,208 cases equal the original Luminary099 program in all 2,048 erasable words. The cases are 4,096 RESTARTS-to-SWRETURN compositions, 28 states at every genuine call site, and 1,024 LONGCYCL and GETCADR task runs, and they reach alarms 1201, 1202, 1203 and both 1204s. The 18,441 strict and sanitizer checks pass, and every sixteenth case matches in VICE. See `docs/LM-EXEC-SERVICES.md`.

## Run Luminary Executive job switches and Waitlist task services as native routines

Luminary099 SPVACIN, SPVAC, CHANG1, CHANG2, JOBSLEEP, JOBWAKE, PRIOCHNG and ENDOFJOB, plus FIXDELAY, VARDELAY, TASKOVER and the T3RUPT vector, are routines of the control-transfer ABI. A job switch now ends at the selected job's entry (or NEWOPS for an interpretive job, or the idle loop), and a task's TASKOVER ends at the next due task or back in the interrupted program. JOBSLEEP and PRIOCHNG also switch to interpretive jobs, which their image bodies did not. FIXDELAY takes its delay from the compiled site table at all 16 genuine call sites. All 9,216 cases equal the original Luminary099 program in all 2,048 erasable words, SUPERBNK, the interrupt-enable bit, channel 11 and the interrupt flag, and they reach alarms 1201, 1202, 1203 and 1204. The 18,463 strict and sanitizer checks pass, and every sixteenth case matches in VICE, in three C64 programs. See `docs/LM-EXEC-JOBS.md`.

## Build the compiled interpretive bodies for Comanche055

The 65 compiled interpretive order bodies and dispatch steps that Luminary099 code uses now also build for Comanche055 (`include/cm_interp.h`), so CM interpretive code can be ported as compiled steps over them. One shared source serves both programs. Each fixed address is spelled `IF_(luminary,comanche)`, and all 85 pairs are checked against both assembly listings; SQRTABRT's alarm exit and the fixed constant pool differ by program. 183,000 differential cases (3,000 for each of 61 bodies) equal the original Comanche055 program in yaAGC in all 2,048 words and the stop address. The 244 frozen vector cases also match on the host, under the sanitizer and in VICE. See `docs/CM-INTERP-BODIES.md`.

## Translate Comanche RESTARTS, RESTART_TABLES and NEWPHASE as transfer-ABI routines

Comanche055 RESTARTS, GETPART2 and PHSPART2 select variable, table and X.1 display restarts natively from RESTART_TABLES words compiled from the source, and run as routines of the control-transfer ABI from RESTARTS to SWRETURN, handing each selected service its 2CADR. NEWPHASE, the executable part of RESTART_TABLES, is a routine entered from its nine `TC NEWPHASE` sites with its group operand compiled from the source. All 7,168 selection cases (including targeted signed-zero and overflow cases), 5,120 RESTARTS-to-SWRETURN compositions and 1,024 NEWPHASE calls equal the original Comanche055 program in all 2,048 erasable words, covering all 79 table entries and all nine NEWPHASE sites (15,908 strict and sanitizer checks), and every sixteenth case matches in VICE. Lane A2 (restart, telemetry and support). See `docs/CM-RESTART-ROUTINES.md`.

## Run Luminary and Comanche IMU mode switching as native routines

Every word of IMU_MODE_SWITCHING_ROUTINES in both programs (660 Luminary099 words, 656 Comanche055 words, in fixed-fixed and banks 07, 04/07 and 37/26) is compiled native C on the control-transfer ABI. The 72 routines per mission cover ZEROICDU, IMUZERO, coarse and fine align, PIPUSE/PIPFREE, gyro torquing (IMUPULSE, STRTGYRO, 8192AUG), the mode ends, the optics and IMU stalls, GOMANUR, R02BOTH and P06/P05, and every point where they resume after an outside call. Channels 11-14 and the interrupt-enable state are part of the comparison. All 64,256 cases equal the original programs in all 2,048 erasable words, the interrupt state and the channels. That is 56,064 runs from each routine to the point where control leaves the file, and 8,192 round trips from every genuine `TC BANKCALL`/`IBNKCALL` of these routines through the native INTER-BANK routines. The yaAGC oracle drops only the engine's gyro, CDU drive and optics device block. The 257,980 strict and sanitizer checks pass, and nine C64 diagnostics pass 1,290 frozen cases in VICE. Round trips stop at SWRETURN/ISWRETRN entered with Q 3 until the INTER-BANK context fix merges. A complete certificate for both files is drafted for the auditor. See `docs/IMU-MODE-SWITCHING.md`.

Update 2026-10-13: the Comanche sextant routines SXTNB, SXTLOGIC, CALCSXA and SXTANG are native too, so CSM_GEOMETRY is native in every word (204 compiled, 49 constants, 91 routines) with a complete certificate drafted. ## Translate Luminary UPDATE_PROGRAM as transfer-ABI routines

Every instruction of Luminary099 UPDATE_PROGRAM (P27: the V70-V73 uplink verbs, data collection and verification, restart-protected stores into erasable memory and the TIME2/TIME1 adjustment) runs as routines of the control-transfer ABI. There are 35 entries: the verbs, the POSTJUMP targets, the job, its post-EXIT code, two restart points and the return after every TC out of the file, plus UPJOB's two interpretive words (CALL INTSTALL, UPWAKE EXIT) registered at NEWOPS as the CHANG2 resume LOCs, with NEWJOB positive in a fifth of their cases. The file's own BANKCALL/POSTJUMP CADRs and constants are compiled from the source listing. 4,096 cases from every entry equal the original Luminary099 program in the interrupt-enable state, SUPERBNK, channel 11 and all 2,048 erasable words. They include even V72 counts, one-word V71 loads at a bank's first word, V71 loads past a bank's end and EB0 targets, and together they execute every instruction of the file (12,666 strict and sanitizer checks, all 35 entries, both interpretive entries and all 14 exits reached). 261 C64 rows chosen by native branch outcome (`tools/a2_c64_rows.py`: every 16th case plus a greedy cover of the gcov branch arcs of every linked source; the freeze fails unless the rows take all 450 arcs the host cases take) match in VICE. Lane A2 (restart, telemetry and support). See `docs/LM-UPDATE.md`.

## Translate Luminary Q_R-AXIS_RCS_AUTOPILOT as transfer-ABI routines

All of Luminary099 Q_R-AXIS_RCS_AUTOPILOT (bank 17 and MAKERUPT in fixed-fixed, 626 words) runs as seventeen native routines of the control-transfer ABI, with channels 4, 5, 13 and 31, the interrupt-enable bit and the interrupt-in-progress bit in `lm_flight_io` (which gains channel 4 and the interrupt-in-progress bit). The routines are CALLQERR (Q,R errors, the GTS/RCS choice, X-translation, minimum impulse, rate command, attitude hold, TJLAW and the U,V jet selection) with its twelve returns from calls that leave the file, CLOSEOUT (MAKERUPT's EDRUPT and ENDJASK), and the subroutines QERRCALC, JTLST and ROT-TOUV. 15,547 of 16,384 cases equal the original program in the outcome, channel 13, both interrupt bits and all 2,048 erasable words (strict and ASAN/UBSAN); the other 837 are refused with the image unchanged (SKIPU or SKIPV other than 0 or 4, ALLOWGTS -0 or channel 5 negative at CALLQERR, a loop return entry with AXISCTR, NUMBERT, SENSETYP or RETJADR outside the values the file stores, or a subroutine return that is not a TC into fixed memory). Every routine and reachable branch is taken, every assembled word maps to its native owner after a fresh yaYUL assembly, and 128 C64 rows chosen to take every entry, outcome and branch the host cases take pass in VICE. See `docs/LM-Q-R-AXIS.md`.

Revised for issue #99: CALLQERR and the returns at 17,2172, 17,2214, 17,2454 and 17,2620 now accept any AXISCTR and NUMBERT (P-AXIS's PURGENCY -1, GTS's SAVESR, PJETSLEC's NUMBERT 5 or 6), since they store both before reading them; a loop return entry with AXISCTR 1 and a RETJADR word other than the file's three return addresses is refused with the image unchanged instead of ending at Z = RETJADR; ROT-TOUV's two LIMITS signs have separate branch counters; and the C64 rows are re-chosen to reach every basic block the host cases reach.

## Translate Comanche UPDATE_PROGRAM as transfer-ABI routines

Every instruction of Comanche055 UPDATE_PROGRAM (P27: the V70-V73 uplink verbs, data collection and verification, restart-protected stores into erasable memory and the TIME2/TIME1 adjustment) runs as routines of the control-transfer ABI. There are 36 entries: the verbs, UPACTOFF (BANKCALL'd from FRESH_START and P20-P25), the POSTJUMP targets, the job, its post-EXIT code, two restart points and the return after every TC out of the file, plus UPJOB's two interpretive words (CALL INTSTALL, UPWAKE EXIT) registered at NEWOPS as the CHANG2 resume LOCs, with NEWJOB positive in a fifth of their cases. The code follows the Luminary translation, plus the Comanche-only CKMDMORE mode check; its constants are compiled from the source listing and its BANKCALL/POSTJUMP CADRs come from the interbank site table. 4,096 cases from every entry equal the original Comanche055 program in the interrupt-enable state, SUPERBNK, channel 11 and all 2,048 erasable words. They include even V72 counts, one-word V71 loads at a bank's first word, V71 loads past a bank's end, EB0 targets and UPACTOFF from both BANKCALL callers, and together they execute every instruction of the file (12,807 strict and sanitizer checks, all 36 entries, both interpretive entries and all 15 exits reached). 285 C64 rows chosen by native branch outcome (`tools/a2_c64_rows.py`: every 16th case plus a greedy cover of the gcov branch arcs of every linked source; the freeze fails unless the rows take all 479 arcs the host cases take) match in VICE; they enter every registered entry, UPACTOFF from both callers, TIMEDIDR and UPOUT+1 among them. Lane A2 (restart, telemetry and support). See `docs/CM-UPDATE.md`.

## Run Comanche Executive job services as native routines

Comanche055 SPVACIN, SPVAC, CHANG1, CHANG2, JOBSLEEP, JOBWAKE, PRIOCHNG and ENDOFJOB are routines of the control-transfer ABI (`cm_exec_job_routines`). Each composes the qualified image body of its source path and leaves Z where the original continues: the caller, the selected basic job, NEWOPS for an interpretive job, the idle loop ADVAN, or JOBWAKE's TC 014 and CCSHOLE exits. All 6,144 cases equal the original Comanche055 program in yaAGC in all 2,048 erasable words, SUPERBNK, the interrupt-enable bit and channel 11. The cases are 1,024 per service group, drawn from each body's qualified input generator, and they reach every kind of continuation and the SPVAC alarms. The 12,306 strict and sanitizer checks pass, and every sixteenth case matches in VICE. With `cm-exec-services`, every EXECUTIVE.agc service that other code calls is now a native routine; the idle loop (ADVAN) is not yet registered. See `docs/CM-EXEC-JOBS.md`.

## Map every word of EXECUTIVE.agc and WAITLIST.agc to the native routines that run it

Every assembled word of EXECUTIVE.agc and WAITLIST.agc in both missions now maps to the native routine milestones whose comparisons with yaAGC ran it. A new tracer (`tools/oracle_trace/`) links into any yaAGC reference and records the fixed words the original executes. The exec milestones' own differentials were rerun under it, and they still pass with unchanged vectors.

Every instruction word of all four files is in a native routine's compared path, apart from named exceptions: the original's own CCSHOLE traps and its CAN'T GET HERE NOOPs.

For the last two LM paths, `lm_basic_wake` now admits a job asleep in core set 0 (a task's JOBWAKE under the dummy job): WAKETEST to SPECTEST. The LM NOVAC and JOBWAKE cases were widened to reach the dormant-job scan and every wake slot. Certificates for all four files are drafted for review. See `docs/EXEC-CLOSURE.md`.

## Translate AGC_BLOCK_TWO_SELF-CHECK (Luminary099 and Comanche055, bank 43) as transfer-ABI routines

Every instruction of AGC_BLOCK_TWO_SELF-CHECK in both missions runs as a native routine of the control-transfer ABI, from one shared body (`src/self_check_body.inc`) that each mission builds with its own addresses and constants. That includes the self-check idle loop SMODECHK with its options, -1CHK, ERRORS/PRERRORS with the ERESTORE repair, ERASCHK, CNTRCHK, CYCLSHFT, and ROPECHK/STSHOSUM with FXADRS, ADSUM, ADRSCHK, NXTBNK and BNKCHK. FXADRS and SUPDACAL read the unmodified rope through a rope image (`include/rope_image.h`: the assembled rope on the host, a 2 MB REU image on the C64) that only this file may use. 4,096 random-state cases per mission from all 11 entries, and 43 whole-rope cases (a full ROPECHK of all 36 banks, the NEWJOB branches, STSHOSUM, and SHOWSUM through every display), equal the original Luminary099 and Comanche055 programs in the interrupt-enable state, SUPERBNK and all 2,048 erasable words. Every instruction of the file is executed but two +0 branch outcomes no state can reach. The C64 rows (77 + 7 for Luminary099, 78 + 7 for Comanche055, one PRG per mission with the REU image) are chosen by native branch outcome (`tools/a2_c64_rows.py`: every 64th random-state case plus a greedy cover of the gcov branch arcs of every source the mission's image links; the freeze fails unless the rows take all the arcs the host cases take: 426 + 392 and 426 + 388) and match in VICE. Completion certificates are pending review (`docs/SELF-CHECK-COMPLETE.md`). Lane A2 (restart, telemetry and support). See `docs/SELF-CHECK.md`.

## Resolve a pending right-hand order at DANZIG in the transfer ABI

The transfer ABI now has a point for an interpretive pair whose left order is RTB. When the RTB routine returns to DANZIG with the right order still in EDOP, and the program carries the mission's DANZIG marker table, the point is LOC under BANKSET. LOC then holds the RTB's operand word, and the file that owns the pair registers its right-order routine there. In yaAGC, 88 RTB-left pairs of both missions reach DANZIG with EDOP positive and LOC at the pair word +1. The 792 strict, sanitizer and VICE checks pass. Programs without the marker resolve DANZIG by Z as before. See `docs/DANZIG-PENDING.md`.

## Run the KEYRUPT and UPRUPT handlers of both missions as native routines

The 9,240 strict and sanitizer checks pass, and every sixteenth case matches in VICE. Complete certificates are drafted for both files. See `docs/KEYRUPT-UPRUPT.md`.

On the C64, one program per module and mission registers INTER-BANK and that module's points: 108 programs run 575 round-trip rows, picked to take every host branch arc, on a VICE PAL C64 (22 modules' programs do not fit below $C000). Refreeze (2026-10-14, merged base with `image_w`): the spec sets `index_carry16` and `image_w`, takes P47BODY (P47LM's FINDVAC job) as an entry, and chooses its C64 rows by branch outcome (`c64_rows: 'cover'`, `cover_stride` 5, `edge_values`, and `c64_cuts` for the arcs only 180MESS's long runs take). All 196,608 compared cases of 206,336 equal the original program in yaAGC; host and sanitizer pass 305 frozen cases; 32 C64 diagnostics pass 439 cases in VICE (4 of them truncated rows) that take every branch arc the compared host cases take. `tools/interp_routine_differential.py` now leaves a partial spec's channel-waiting cases out of the host side of its gcov comparison and `--cover-check`. The 17 output-channel words still wait for Lane D1's output-channel model; the file stays partial.

Whole file (2026-10-14): the 17 output-channel words (WAND/WOR CHAN12 in TRIMGIMB and PITCHOFF, RAND/WRITE DSALMOUT and WOR CHAN14 in ENGINOF3) compile as calls to the shared channel model (`include/agc_channel_ops.h`) on the program's `agc_hardware`: the spec drops `partial` and sets `'channels': 'all'`, `channel_inputs`, `io_channels` (11, 12, 14), `trusted_image`, and `any_fixloc`/`any_newjob` for the Waitlist tasks' basic routines, which run in T3RUPT whatever job is waiting. All 931 words are native, as 385 routines. Of 197,120 cases, one loops on both sides and is left out; all 197,119 compared cases equal the original program in yaAGC, channels 11, 12 and 14 included, with none waiting for a channel and none refused. Host and sanitizer pass 308 frozen cases; 40 C64 diagnostics pass 468 cases in VICE (27 truncated rows) that take all 2,580 branch arcs the host cases take. A pending certificate awaits the certificate reviewer. See `docs/LM-P40-P47.md`.

## Kernel C64 rows by branch cover, flight edges, and the #143/#144 fixes

The C64 programs of the nine kernel milestones (`lm-t6rupt`, `rupt-lead-ins`, `keyrupt-uprupt` and the six Executive milestones) now run, beyond every third case, the fewest extra cases that take every branch arc the host corpus takes in every linked source (`tools/lane_a_c64_cover.py`); all nine pass in VICE. All of Luminary099 and Comanche055 MEASUREMENT_INCORPORATION (384 and 385 words: INCORP1, NEWZCOMP and INCORP2, the rendezvous navigation filter's measurement update that P20-P25 run for every mark) are native C on the control-transfer ABI, as 160 routines per mission compiled by tools/interp_compile.py, with native RTB TPMODE and the MOVE* state-vector copies (the new src/cm_integration_moves.c for Comanche). The differential gained 'flow_from': every routine but the entries starts from the state the original program reaches there from INCORP1 or INCORP2, run on through the outside code it calls, with QPRET pinned to a fixed CADR so interpretive entries return where the run ends. All 163,840 cases equal the original programs in yaAGC, with all 314 resume points flowed. The strict and sanitizer host tests pass 2,560 frozen cases, and 18 C64 diagnostics pass 354 cases in VICE that take all 2,251 host branch outcomes. Both files have pending complete certificates for the certificate reviewer. See `docs/MEASUREMENT-INCORPORATION.md`.
